  \caption{Schema of the released longitudinal corpus. Every field in every released file.}
  \label{tab:schema}
  \begin{tabular}{llp{0.56\linewidth}}
    \toprule
    Field & Type & Description \\
    \midrule
    \multicolumn{3}{l}{\textit{\texttt{longitudinal\_\textless{}project\textgreater{}.csv}}} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{date} & ISO-8601 datetime & Author timestamp of the sampled commit. \\
    \texttt{sha} & string (40 hex) & Full git commit SHA the snapshot was extracted at. \\
    \texttt{commit\_msg} & string & Commit subject line, truncated to 120 characters. \\
    \texttt{N} & integer & Nodes in the lineage DAG, one per resolved dbt model. \\
    \texttt{M} & integer & Directed edges, one per ref() call between two resolved models. \\
    \texttt{too\_small} & boolean & True when N \textless{} 5 and the D1-D4 descriptors were skipped. False throughout the release. \\
    \texttt{D1\_csi} & float [0,1] & Community stability index. Fraction of consecutive steps in a 15-point Louvain resolution sweep whose partitions differ by NVI \textless{} 0.1. \\
    \texttt{D1\_n\_comm} & integer & Communities found at Louvain resolution gamma = 1. \\
    \texttt{D2\_max\_gini} & float [0,1] & Maximum over depth of the Gini coefficient of the blast-radius distribution. \\
    \texttt{D3\_alg\_conn} & float $\geq$ 0 & Algebraic connectivity, the second-smallest Laplacian eigenvalue of the undirected connected skeleton. \\
    \texttt{D3\_norm\_gap} & float [0,1] & Algebraic connectivity divided by the largest Laplacian eigenvalue. \\
    \texttt{D3\_fiedler\_bim} & float [0,1] & Bimodality coefficient of the Fiedler vector. \\
    \texttt{D4\_cycle\_rank\_norm} & float $\geq$ 0 & Cycle rank (M - N + C) of the undirected skeleton, divided by N. \\
    \midrule
    \multicolumn{3}{l}{\textit{\texttt{drift\_events\_refined.csv}}} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{project} & string & cal-itp or mattermost. \\
    \texttt{date} & ISO-8601 date & Date of the later snapshot in the pair that produced the step change. \\
    \texttt{descriptor} & string & Which descriptor drifted. One of D1\_csi, D3\_alg\_conn, D4\_cycle\_rank\_norm. \\
    \texttt{prev} & float & Descriptor value at the preceding snapshot. \\
    \texttt{curr} & float & Descriptor value at this snapshot. \\
    \texttt{pct\_change} & float \textgreater{} 20 & 100 * \textbar{}curr - prev\textbar{} / \textbar{}prev\textbar{}. Rows are emitted only above 20. \\
    \texttt{commit\_msg} & string & Commit subject line at the later snapshot. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
